blocks.text: just, already, yet — Present Perfect bilan

15-darsda Present Perfect o'tmishdagi harakatni hozirgi natija bilan bog'lashini ko'rdik. Bu zamon bilan ko'pincha uchta kichik so'z keladi: **just**, **already** va **yet**. Ular harakat **hozirgi paytga nisbatan** qachon bo'lganini — yoki hali bo'lmaganini — ko'rsatadi. O'zbekchada: **just** — «hozirgina, endigina»; **already** — «allaqachon», «-ib bo'ldi»; **yet** — inkorda «hali ... -madi», savolda «... -dimi?» (kutyapmiz).

rows: I haven't eaten **yet**. / Have you eaten **yet**?

blocks.text: **just** — harakat bir necha daqiqa yoki juda yaqinda bo'lib o'tdi, natijasi hali «issiq»: The taxi has **just** arrived — taksi hozirgina keldi (hozir eshik oldida). O'rni — **have / has** va V3 orasida: I**'ve just** finished. O'zbekchada «hozirgina», «endigina» gap boshida yoki fe'l oldida turadi, inglizchada esa just doim yordamchi fe'ldan keyin.

items.text: I**'ve just seen** Aziz in the corridor.

blocks.text: **already** — harakat kutilganidan **oldinroq** bo'ldi: «Unga aytmoqchi edim, lekin u allaqachon bilib olibdi». O'rni ham **have / has** va V3 orasida: She**'s already** heard the news. O'zbekchada «allaqachon» yoki «**-ib bo'ldi**», «**-ib qo'ydi**»: Tugatib bo'ldim, Pul to'lab qo'ydim. Savolda already hayratni bildiradi: **Have** you **already** finished? — Tugatib ham bo'ldingizmi? (Shuncha tez?)

items.text: Don't cook — I**'ve already ordered** pizza.

blocks.text: **yet** faqat **inkor** va **savol** gaplarda ishlatiladi va doim **gap oxirida** turadi. Inkorda: I haven't finished **yet** — Hali tugatmadim (lekin tugatishim kutilyapti). Savolda: Have you finished **yet**? — Tugatdingizmi? (kutyapman). O'zbekchada «hali» gap boshida yoki o'rtasida keladi, shuning uchun o'zbeklar yet ni ham oldinga qo'yishga urinadi — inglizchada u oxirida.

Ikkalasi ham «kutish» bilan bog'liq. **already** — kutilgan narsa bo'lib bo'ldi, hatto ertaroq (darak gap). **yet** — kutilgan narsa hali bo'lmadi (inkor) yoki bo'ldimi-yo'qmi bilmaymiz (savol). Savolda farq nozik: Has she left **yet**? — oddiy savol («Ketdimi?»); Has she **already** left? — hayrat («Ketib ham qoldimi? Shuncha tez?»).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have finished yet.» → I've **already** finished. (yet darak gapda ishlatilmaydi); «I haven't yet eaten.» → I haven't eaten **yet**. (so'zlashuvda yet — oxirida); «I just have eaten.» → I've **just** eaten. (just — have va V3 orasida); «Already I have done it.» → I've **already** done it.; «I've just arrived five minutes ago.» → I **arrived** five minutes ago yoki I've **just** arrived. (aniq vaqt bilan Present Perfect bo'lmaydi — 20-dars).

Joylashuvni eslab qolish: **just** va **already** — have / has va V3 **o'rtasida** (I've just / already done); **yet** — **gap oxirida** (... yet). Ma'nosi: just — «bir lahza oldin», already — «kutilganidan oldin», yet — «hali kutilyapti».

Amerika ingliz tilida just / already / yet bilan Past Simple ham ishlatiladi (I just ate. Did you eat yet?). British English da — Present Perfect. **just** ning yana bir ma'nosi — «faqat, shunchaki»: I'm **just** looking. still / yet / already boshqa zamonlar bilan — 95-dars.

examples.title: **just**: it happened a moment ago
examples.description: have / has + **just** + V3 — harakat hozirgina bo'ldi. O'zbekchada: «hozirgina», «endigina».

sentences.text: **I've just had** lunch, so I'm not hungry.
sentences.translation: **Hozirgina tushlik qildim**, shuning uchun qornim och emas.

sentences.text: Come on, the taxi **has just arrived**!
sentences.translation: Qani, taksi **hozirgina keldi**!

sentences.text: Madina **has just called** — she's on her way.
sentences.translation: Madina **hozirgina qo'ng'iroq qildi** — u yo'lda ekan.

sentences.text: We**'ve just moved** into a new flat in Yunusabad.
sentences.translation: Biz Yunusoboddagi yangi kvartiraga **endigina ko'chib o'tdik**.

sentences.text: Look out of the window — it**'s just started** to snow!
sentences.translation: Derazadan qarang — **endigina qor yog'a boshladi**!

sentences.text: Tom **has just come** back from Japan, and he's very tired.
sentences.translation: Tom Yaponiyadan **hozirgina qaytdi**, juda charchagan.

sentences.text: Careful! I**'ve just washed** the floor.
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling! Polni **hozirgina yuvdim**.

sentences.text: The film **has just started**, so you haven't missed much.
sentences.translation: Film **endigina boshlandi**, ko'p narsani o'tkazib yubormadingiz.

sentences.text: Sorry, Mr Brown **has just gone** out. Can you call back later?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, janob Braun **hozirgina chiqib ketdi**. Keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qila olasizmi?

sentences.text: Dilnoza and Aziz **have just got** married, and they're on their honeymoon in Bali.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan Aziz **endigina turmush qurishdi**, hozir Balida asal oyini o'tkazishyapti.

examples.title: **already**: sooner than expected
examples.description: have / has + **already** + V3 — harakat kutilganidan oldin bo'ldi. O'zbekchada: «allaqachon», «-ib bo'ldi», «-ib qo'ydi», «-ib ham oldi».

sentences.text: **I've already paid** for the coffee, so put your money away.
sentences.translation: Qahva uchun **allaqachon to'lab qo'ydim**, pulingizni yig'ishtiring.

sentences.text: Don't tell Emma the news — she**'s already heard** it.
sentences.translation: Emmaga yangilikni aytmang — u **allaqachon eshitgan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve already seen** this film twice!
sentences.translation: Bu filmni **allaqachon ikki marta ko'rganmiz**!

sentences.text: It's only ten o'clock, but Bekzod **has already finished** his work.
sentences.translation: Soat endi o'n, lekin Bekzod ishini **tugatib bo'libdi**.

sentences.text: The shop is almost empty — people **have already bought** all the bread.
sentences.translation: Do'kon deyarli bo'm-bo'sh — odamlar hamma nonni **sotib olib bo'lishibdi**.

sentences.text: Are you looking for Sarah? She**'s already left**.
sentences.translation: Sarani qidiryapsizmi? U **allaqachon ketib qoldi**.

sentences.text: My little brother **has already learnt** to read, and he's only four!
sentences.translation: Ukam endi to'rt yoshda, lekin **o'qishni o'rganib ham oldi**!

sentences.text: Thanks, but I**'ve already booked** a hotel.
sentences.translation: Rahmat, lekin mehmonxonani **band qilib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **already finished** the whole book? That was quick!
sentences.translation: Butun kitobni **o'qib ham bo'ldingizmi**? Juda tez-ku!

sentences.text: Grandma **has already made** the plov, and the guests are on their way.
sentences.translation: Buvim **palovni damlab bo'ldi**, mehmonlar esa yo'lda.

examples.title: Negative: **haven't** ... **yet**
examples.description: Inkor + **yet** (gap oxirida) — kutilgan harakat hali bo'lmadi. O'zbekchada: «hali ... -madi», «hali ... -gani yo'q».

sentences.text: **I haven't had** breakfast **yet**, and I'm starving.
sentences.translation: Hali **nonushta qilganim yo'q**, qornim juda och.

sentences.text: The bus **hasn't come yet**, and it's already twenty past eight.
sentences.translation: Avtobus **hali kelmadi**, soat esa sakkizdan yigirma o'tdi.

sentences.text: We **haven't chosen** a name for the baby **yet**.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloqqa **hali ism tanlamadik**.

sentences.text: Tom **hasn't replied** to my message **yet**.
sentences.translation: Tom xabarimga **hali javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: Don't worry, the concert **hasn't started yet**.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olmang, konsert **hali boshlanmadi**.

sentences.text: My sister **has bought** a dress, but she **hasn't chosen** her shoes **yet**.
sentences.translation: Opam ko'ylak **sotib oldi**, lekin tuflini **hali tanlamadi**.

sentences.text: It's March, but the weather **hasn't got** warm **yet**.
sentences.translation: Mart oyi bo'lsa ham, havo **hali isimadi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **haven't read** the report **yet**. Is it urgent?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, hisobotni **hali o'qimadim**. Shoshilinchmi?

sentences.text: The children **haven't finished** their homework **yet**, so no TV!
sentences.translation: Bolalar uy vazifasini **hali tugatishmadi**, shuning uchun televizor yo'q!

sentences.text: Aziz is in London on business, but he **hasn't seen** Big Ben **yet**.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonda xizmat safarida, lekin **Big Benni hali ko'rmadi**.

examples.title: **Have** you ... **yet**? — Yes / No, not **yet**
examples.description: Savol + **yet**: kutilgan narsa bo'ldimi? Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I have. / No, not yet. O'zbekchada «yet» ko'pincha tarjima qilinmaydi: «Keldimi?»

sentences.text: **Have** you **finished** your homework **yet**? — Yes, I've just finished.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifangni **tugatdingmi**? — Ha, hozirgina tugatdim.

sentences.text: **Has** the post **arrived yet**? — No, not **yet**.
sentences.translation: Pochta **keldimi**? — Yo'q, **hali kelmadi**.

sentences.text: **Has** Madina **found** a job **yet**? — No, she's still looking.
sentences.translation: Madina **ish topdimi**? — Yo'q, hali qidiryapti.

sentences.text: **Have** your parents **met** your new girlfriend **yet**?
sentences.translation: Ota-onang yangi qiz do'sting bilan **tanishishdimi**?

sentences.text: Emma, **have** you **booked** the tickets **yet**?
sentences.translation: Emma, chiptalarni **band qildingmi**?

sentences.text: So **has** the doctor **called** you back **yet**?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, shifokor sizga **qayta qo'ng'iroq qildimi**?

sentences.text: **Have** they **fixed** the lift **yet**? — Yes, they **have**. It works now.
sentences.translation: Liftni **tuzatishdimi**? — Ha, **tuzatishdi**. Endi ishlayapti.

sentences.text: Is dinner ready? **Have** you **put** the rice on **yet**?
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat tayyormi? **Guruchni qo'ydingmi**?

sentences.text: Bekzod, **has** your brother **paid** you back **yet**? — No, not a penny!
sentences.translation: Bekzod, akang **qarzini qaytardimi**? — Yo'q, bir tiyin ham!

sentences.text: What about the wedding? **Have** Aziz and Madina **chosen** a date **yet**?
sentences.translation: To'y-chi? Aziz bilan Madina **sanani belgilashdimi**?

examples.title: **already** done, **not** done **yet**
examples.description: Tasdiq ↔ inkor yonma-yon: nima qilib bo'lindi (**already**) va nima hali qilinmadi (**yet**).

sentences.text: I**'ve already packed** my suitcase, but I **haven't printed** my ticket **yet**.
sentences.translation: Chamadonimni **yig'ib bo'ldim**, lekin chiptamni **hali chop etmadim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has already cleaned** the kitchen, but she **hasn't done** the bathroom **yet**.
sentences.translation: Sara oshxonani **tozalab bo'ldi**, lekin vannaxonani **hali tozalamadi**.

sentences.text: Has she left **yet**? — Yes, she**'s already gone**.
sentences.translation: U **ketdimi**? — Ha, **allaqachon ketib qoldi**.

sentences.text: We **haven't bought** a present for Mum **yet**, and her birthday is tomorrow!
sentences.translation: Oyimga **hali sovg'a olmadik**, tug'ilgan kuni esa ertaga!

sentences.text: The guests **have already arrived**, but the food isn't ready **yet**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar **kelib bo'lishdi**, ovqat esa **hali tayyor emas**.

sentences.text: Tom **has already spent** half of his salary, and it's only the tenth!
sentences.translation: Tom maoshining yarmini **sarflab bo'libdi**, bugun esa endi o'ninchi sana!

sentences.text: **Have** you **already told** your parents, or **haven't** you **told** them **yet**?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangga **aytib bo'ldingmi**, yoki **hali aytmadingmi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **hasn't answered** the letter **yet** — she**'s only just read** it.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza xatga **hali javob bermadi** — uni **endigina o'qidi**.

sentences.text: Oh no, the film **has already started**, and we **haven't found** our seats **yet**!
sentences.translation: Voy, film **boshlanib ketibdi**, biz esa **hali joyimizni topmadik**!

sentences.text: Aziz **has already learnt** two hundred English words, but he **hasn't started** on grammar **yet**.
sentences.translation: Aziz ikki yuzta inglizcha so'zni **yodlab bo'ldi**, lekin grammatikaga **hali kirishmadi**.

examples.title: No, thanks — I**'ve just had** one
examples.description: Taklif, iltimos yoki maslahatga javob: No, thanks, I've just had one. / I've already done it. Kundalik suhbatda juda ko'p eshitiladi.

sentences.text: Do you want some tea? — No, thanks. I**'ve just had** a cup.
sentences.translation: Choy ichasizmi? — Yo'q, rahmat. **Hozirgina bir piyola ichdim**.

sentences.text: Can you buy some bread? — I**'ve already bought** it. It's in the kitchen.
sentences.translation: Non olib kela olasizmi? — **Olib qo'ydim**. Oshxonada.

sentences.text: Don't forget to call Grandma! — It's OK, I**'ve just spoken** to her.
sentences.translation: Buvingga qo'ng'iroq qilishni unutma! — Xavotir olma, **hozirgina gaplashdim**.

sentences.text: Why don't you read this book? — I**'ve already read** it twice!
sentences.translation: Nega bu kitobni o'qimaysan? — **Ikki marta o'qib bo'lganman**!

sentences.text: Is Emma here? — No, she**'s just left** — you can still catch her.
sentences.translation: Emma shu yerdami? — Yo'q, **hozirgina chiqib ketdi** — hali yetib olasiz.

sentences.text: Let's watch the new James Bond film. — Oh, we**'ve already seen** it.
sentences.translation: Yangi Jeyms Bond filmini ko'raylik. — E, biz uni **allaqachon ko'rganmiz**.

sentences.text: Where's Tom? — He**'s just gone** to the shop for some milk.
sentences.translation: Tom qani? — **Hozirgina** sut olgani do'konga **ketdi**.

sentences.text: Please wash the dishes. — But Mum, I**'ve already washed** them!
sentences.translation: Iltimos, idishlarni yuv. — Lekin oyi, **yuvib bo'ldim**-ku!

sentences.text: Are you hungry? — Not really, we**'ve just eaten** at Madina's.
sentences.translation: Qorningiz ochmi? — Unchalik emas, **hozirgina** Madinanikida **ovqatlandik**.

sentences.text: Hurry, the shop closes at six! — Relax, Bekzod **has already gone** there.
sentences.translation: Shoshil, do'kon oltida yopiladi! — Xotirjam bo'l, Bekzod **allaqachon ketgan**.

examples.title: Before the trip: what **have** they **done**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: safar oldidan tayyorgarlik — nima qilib bo'lindi (just, already) va nima hali qilinmadi (yet).

sentences.text: The Karimov family **have already got** their visas for the UK.
sentences.translation: Karimovlar oilasi Buyuk Britaniya vizasini **olib bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: Mr Karimov **has just booked** a hotel near Hyde Park.
sentences.translation: Janob Karimov Hayd-park yaqinidagi mehmonxonani **hozirgina band qildi**.

sentences.text: His wife **has already bought** presents for their English friends.
sentences.translation: Xotini ingliz do'stlari uchun **sovg'alar olib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: But they **haven't changed** any money **yet**.
sentences.translation: Lekin **hali pul almashtirishmadi**.

sentences.text: Their son **hasn't packed** his bag **yet** — he's playing games on his phone!
sentences.translation: O'g'illari **hali sumkasini yig'madi** — telefonida o'yin o'ynayapti!

sentences.text: Their daughter **has just finished** her packing and is checking the list again.
sentences.translation: Qizlari **endigina narsalarini yig'ib bo'ldi** va ro'yxatni yana tekshiryapti.

sentences.text: **Has** anybody **checked** the flight time **yet**?
sentences.translation: Parvoz vaqtini **kimdir tekshirdimi**?

sentences.text: Grandma **has already cooked** food for the journey.
sentences.translation: Buvi yo'l uchun **ovqat tayyorlab qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: The taxi to the airport **hasn't arrived yet**, and everybody is getting nervous.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga taksi **hali kelmadi**, hamma xavotirlana boshladi.

sentences.text: Oh, wait — it**'s just stopped** outside the house. Let's go!
sentences.translation: To'xtang — u **hozirgina** uy oldida **to'xtadi**. Ketdik!

examples.title: Dialogue: **Have** you **called** a taxi **yet**?
examples.description: Suhbatda just, already va yet birga: tayyorgarlik, savol va javoblar.

sentences.text: — Emma, **have** you **got** dressed **yet**? The film starts at eight.
sentences.translation: — Emma, **kiyinib bo'ldingmi**? Film sakkizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: — Almost! I**'ve just dried** my hair.
sentences.translation: — Deyarli! **Hozirgina sochimni quritdim**.

sentences.text: — **Have** you **called** a taxi **yet**?
sentences.translation: — **Taksi chaqirdingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I**'ve already called** one. It's coming in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **chaqirib qo'ydim**. O'n daqiqada keladi.

sentences.text: — Great. **Has** your brother **given** you the tickets?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Akang senga **chiptalarni berdimi**?

sentences.text: — No, he **hasn't** — he **hasn't come** home from work **yet**.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **bermadi** — u ishdan **hali qaytmadi**.

sentences.text: — Oh no! **Has** he **bought** them online at least?
sentences.translation: — Voy! Hech bo'lmasa ularni internetdan **sotib oldimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, he **has**. He**'s just sent** them to my phone — look!
sentences.translation: — Ha, **oldi**. **Hozirgina** telefonimga **yubordi** — qara!

sentences.text: — Perfect! Oh, and I**'ve already fed** the cat, so we can go.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Aytgancha, mushukni **ovqatlantirib qo'ydim**, ketaversak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — Wait — I **haven't found** my other shoe **yet**!
sentences.translation: — To'xta — ikkinchi poyabzalimni **hali topmadim**!
